title: Carmen - tour guide was fabulous
text: The tour was a 6 out of 5!! The Best because of Carnen our private tour guide! she was so amazing, first of all, knowledgeable, and adapted to exactly what our needs !!
author: Jim_A

title: The tour with ONA was the...
text: The tour with ONA was the best I have ever had with Viator.  Maria was so detailed and answered every question we had. We were on the move and the time went quickly.  Refer your clients to her if they want to visit the park and the cathedral.
author: Howard_F

title: A wonderful afternoon of gaudi
text:
We had a fabulous guide. He shared a plethora of information on guell and gaudi! We walked he talked we asked he answered!
He included cultural information in his explanations!
I felt like i had my own professor! His story of the Sagrada Familia was fascinating! With the history, the reasons, the generational perspectives! Amazing!
author: Lynda_A

title: This was a very nice...
text: This was a very nice tour. We had 8 people so it was intimate and we didn’t have to mess with headphones. Steven is very well educated and has a lot of patience. He answered all questions and gave us great insights.
author: David_R

title: Great Guide. Organized. As Advertised.
text:
Our guide, Steven, was amazing and the tour was exactly as advertised. Everything was well planned and organized. 5 stars.

What amazing sights to see with a great guide even on a rainy day.
author: pgqqsjzfp6

title: Barcelona
text: Great tour just wish we had more time inside to explore on our own. Wine and tapas were a nice treat afterwards.
author: Michelle_S

title: An excellent tour experience and guide!
text: Steven, our guide, was highly knowledgeable and entertaining.  He pointed out all kinds of historical details that I doubt we would have researched ourselves.  Any creation by Gaudy has a lot of nuance and you will miss a lot if you just dash through Guell and the Sagrada.  We highly enjoyed the tour!
author: Donn_D

title: Fantastic Tour
text: Gonzales’ enthusiasm and expertise made for a fun, intellectually satisfying, artistic, and friendly experience. We are grateful for all he shared with us. He is an expert on Gaudi and the history of Barcelona and Spain.
author: Ludwig_F

title: Can’t wait to return
text: Maria, our tour guide, was just incredible! Filled with so much passion and knowledge about the lives and creations of both Guell and Gaudi. She made our experience so enriching. And Happy Birthday Maria!
author: Teresa_R

title: Informative passion
text: Gonzalo was fantastic spoke with great knowledge and happiness sharing his city with the group which was a great privilege to hear. Thank you for bringing the amazing Gaudi masterpieces to life.
author: cherryfl0wer
